data.coverage_note: 2-star covers the full 10 weeks; 1-star from 10 Sep and 3-star from 25 Aug (fetch caps). Weekly trends use 2-star only for a like-for-like comparison.

themes.name: Free-plan limits & upgrade pressure
themes.summary: Free users hit caps on images (often 1-3), attachments, chat and voice, then get cooldowns of hours and repeated upgrade prompts. Includes ~950 reviews that are about image *limits*, not image quality.

themes.name: App bugs, login & update regressions
themes.summary: Endless sign-in loading, crashes, lag, broken select-all/copy, missing dark mode, chats not syncing or disappearing, low voice volume after updates.

themes.name: Answer quality & instruction-following
themes.summary: Wrong answers given confidently, ignores instructions, forgets context mid-chat; users cross-check with Gemini.

themes.name: Image quality & content-policy blocks
themes.summary: Faces altered in edits, output not matching the prompt, harmless requests blocked as policy violations.

themes.name: Trust, privacy & ethics
themes.summary: Data/privacy worries, perceived bias, environmental (water) concerns.

ranking_caveat: T3, T2 and T4 are within 0.4 points of each other; keyword sizing cannot separate them. T3 ranked above T4 because regressions are directly actionable by the app team this week.

quotes.text: We can ask questions for free, but when it comes to generating images, it works only once or twice before asking us to upgrade and pay. Why call it a free app if image generation is so limited?
I can't open or log in to this app, I have clear the cache and data anything but it is stuck on an endless loading for sign in.
worst app galat answer deta haiii haar baar gemini pe jaake cross check karna paadta haiii . har 10 mcq me se 4 galat bata ta haiii.
quotes.translation: Worst app, gives wrong answers; every time I have to cross-check on Gemini. It gets 4 out of 10 MCQs wrong.

fee_issue.name: Free-plan limits vs the paid upgrade (ChatGPT Go / Plus)
what_users_are_confused_about: What the free plan actually includes, and why it is called free if images stop after 1-3
Why limits differ between users and how to see how much is left
When a limit resets, and why the upgrade prompt still appears after the cooldown
Whether text chat continues once image/file limits are hit
What paying for ChatGPT Go or Plus unlocks, and billing problems (paid but plan not active, charged after stopping use, cancelling)

evidence.trend: Share of 2-star complaints about limits/upgrades rose from ~15% (early Aug) to 24-29% (mid-Sep to early Oct).

supporting_quotes.text: The dont say why some users have 1 picture to generate(me) and some 3-5. they are hiding that info.
Sometimes I have to upgrade, but it's not free, but the limit has expired, so why is it showing the upgrade already?
i have pay for chatgpt go why not active??

method: Themes found by reading the 515-review weekly sample (LLM step), then sized with keyword rules across all 12,257 substantive complaints (size_themes.py). Keyword sizing is approximate and multi-label; 45% of substantive complaints were too vague or in another script to tag.
